title: Scripts metadata: startup command, parameters, order, and PowerShell ordering

provenance.note: R2 native INI captures plus the clean R10 Import-GPO/report/Backup-GPO run establish the Scripts metadata round trip. This remains metadata evidence only; payload execution is outside scope.

anchors.note: Banked native PowerShell scripts.ini capture with RunPSFirst ordering.
Clean R10 run passed 21/21 checks with exact report metadata and rebackup INI bytes.

derivations: Native legacy scripts.ini is UTF-16LE with BOM and CRLF and carries the two command entries with their parameter positions.
Native psscripts.ini carries StartExecutePSFirst=true and the PowerShell startup entry.
This scenario asserts metadata import/render/rebackup only; script payload execution and endpoint policy processing are outside scope.
